verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.01 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2022 (90% interval −0.00 to +0.03). The same test was run on 47 untouched control cells. In 42 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.90). Counted by gap size instead, 15 of the 47 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.33). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.02).
